svg.text: ROUND 355 · 🏆 355-FAQ, BRK-720 & 1,542-ASSERTION MILESTONE · GLOBAL CUSTODY (STATE STREET ALPHA / ALADDIN) & PROXY VOTING
Global Custody & Asset Servicing (State Street Alpha/Aladdin), Proxy Voting & Actions AI Security FAQ
Sovereign/Pension TAA Rebalancing Flow Air-Gap + Proxy Ballot & Share-Recall Lock vs. DEFC14A Proxy Injection & MT564 Wire Fraud (BRK-719 / BRK-720)
🚨 1. Top 3 Global Custody & Proxy Voting Threat Vectors
① Contested DEFC14A Proxy Injection Leaking TAA Flow (BRK-719)
• Adversarial activist hedge fund DEFC14A proxy fight filing or
issuer supplemental ESG circular PDF embeds prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading Sovereign Wealth / Pension Tactical
Asset Allocation (TAA) rebalancing order flow & M&A vote slates
② Broadridge Proxy Ballot Flip & Share-Recall Suppression (BRK-719)
• Flips institutional stewardship (ISS/Glass Lewis) vote instructions
on contested board seats in Broadridge ProxyEdge
• Cancels securities lending share recalls prior to Record Date
• Impact: Loss of voting rights on $B stakes & ERISA fiduciary breach
③ Spoofed SWIFT MT564 Corporate Action & Nostro Fraud (BRK-720)
• Forged sub-custodian voluntary tender offer / rights subscription
or withholding tax reclaim notice overwrites Nostro IBAN
• Triggers unauthorized $5,200 subscription wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Custody client cash loss & strict custodian liability
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Global Custody & Stewardship Architecture
Gate 1: DEFC14A Proxy / MT564 Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text proxy solicitor narratives; extracts ISO 20022
(seev) typed slots (ISIN, meeting ID, resolution code, record date)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Front-Office TAA Order Flow & Vote Slate Air-Gap
• Aladdin/Alpha front-office quarterly rebalancing order queues &
unannounced M&A vote slates isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Share-Recall & Stewardship Policy Lock
• Hardcoded T-5 securities lending share recall on contested meetings;
AI cannot flip ProxyEdge ballots or cancel lending recalls
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% ballot/recall tamper block)
Gate 4: Read-Only CSD / Sub-Custodian Nostro Registry
• Locks CSD/sub-custodian Nostro IBANs in trust-registry (tool-
allowlist + fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Global Custody & Asset Servicing Security Compared:
A. Capability Broker + TAA Air-Gap + Ballot Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-719/720 | SEC Rule 206(4)-6 & ERISA ready
B. Native State Street Alpha / Aladdin / ProxyEdge RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared stewardship bot is hijacked via DEFC14A PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to Record Date share-recall windows & ISO 20022 seev
D. Manual Custody Operations Review of MT564s & Proxy Filings
✕ Proxy season bottleneck; missed tender deadlines cost millions
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 355 · 355 FAQs!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows ballot flip, TAA leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks sovereign TAA order flow read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks ProxyEdge flip & recall cancel (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks rebalancing order flow egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks Nostro trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,200 tender subscription wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 355 · 🏆 355 FAQs, BRK-720 & 1,542 Assertions Milestone!)
✅ 1. Front-to-Back Order Air-Gap: Isolate front-office Aladdin TAA rebalancing queues & M&A vote slates from custody agents
✅ 2. Deterministic Share-Recall & Ballot Lock: Auto-trigger T-5 lending recalls on contested meetings; require Stewardship Officer FIDO2
✅ 3. Golden-Copy Corporate Action Verification: Cross-verify MT564 tender offers against CSD (DTCC/Euroclear); lock trust-registry
